name: Hoan Kiem Lake
kicker: The lake path, with Turtle Tower in the water
summary: Walk the path around Hoan Kiem before you buy a ticket. The lake path is free and open all day. Turtle Tower stands in the water. Ngoc Son Temple, on the island, is a separate gate, and the two published hour tables do not match. Skip the temple ticket if you only came for the walk.
fee: Lake path free. Temple ticket separate.
getThere: Walk from the lanes north of the lake
heroCaption: Turtle Tower in Hoan Kiem Lake

notice.title: The path and the temple are different tickets
notice.body: Vietnam Tourism says the lake path is free and open all day. Ngoc Son Temple has its own ticket. The management board and Vietnam Tourism do not print the same hours.

body: Walk the shore. Turtle Tower stands in the lake, and the willows line the near bank. The path itself does not need a ticket. Vietnam Tourism says it is free and open all day.

Ngoc Son Temple sits on the island, reached by the The Huc bridge. The management board dates Nguyen Van Sieu’s renovation to 1864 and says the bridge name means where the morning sun rests. The temple worships Tran Hung Dao and Van Xuong. That visit is a separate gate from the walk.

The management board prints Monday to Thursday 7:00 to 19:00, and Friday to Sunday and holidays 7:00 to 22:00, with an adult ticket of 50,000 VND from 1 January 2024. Vietnam Tourism prints Monday to Friday 7:00 to 18:00, Saturday and Sunday 7:00 to 22:00, and the same 50,000 VND. Use both clocks. The minutes from a named hotel are check on arrival.

figures.caption: The willow shore of Hoan Kiem, without the tower filling the frame
figures.alt: Willow trees along the shore of Hoan Kiem Lake in Hanoi

gettingThere: The lake is the center of the walk. Start from the lanes north of it, or from the streets south of it around the Opera House. No published minute count from a named hotel was on the pages used here.

legs.heading: From the lanes north of the lake
legs.body: Walk. The path is free. The minutes from a particular lane are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From south of the lake
legs.body: Walk to the shore. A car minute was not published. Check on arrival.

hours: Lake path: open all day (Vietnam Tourism). Ngoc Son Temple, management board: Monday–Thursday 7:00–19:00; Friday–Sunday and holidays 7:00–22:00. Vietnam Tourism: Monday–Friday 7:00–18:00; Saturday–Sunday 7:00–22:00.
admissionNote: The lake path is free. The temple ticket is separate. Adult 50,000 VND on both the management board (from 1 January 2024) and Vietnam Tourism. The board also prints half price 25,000 VND and free under 16. The two hour tables do not match. Both are above.
